// Two-package fixture for the fixture builder. root reaches os/exec, cobra and
// the sibling fixture package helperpkg, so it type-checks only through an
// importer backed by the shared load's graph — a stdlib-only importer fails on
// cobra. TestFixtureTypeChecksOnTheSharedGraph loads it in both file orders.
package root

import (
	"os/exec"

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"

	"example.com/fixture/helperpkg"
)

// Command prints a spawned process's output through cobra's stdout.
func Command() *cobra.Command {
	return &cobra.Command{
		Use: "probe",
		RunE: func(c *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
			out, err := helperpkg.Run(exec.Command("git", "status"))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_, err = c.OutOrStdout().Write(out)
			return err
		},
	}
}
